extDescription.message: Local browser control over native messaging. Driven by the `browse` CLI.

panelNoDomains.message: None yet — every risky action still asks.

panelNoAnswer.message: no answer from the service worker

settingsIntro.message: These are the same settings the command line reads. They live in one file:

settingsConfirmMode.message: When to ask before a risky action

settingsModeSilent.message: silent — never ask, just do it (default)

settingsModeSilentHint.message: Reading cookies, running JS in a page, downloading files, reading history: all run straight away and only go into the audit log.

settingsModePerDomainHint.message: The first risky action on a site opens a window and asks; after you agree that site stops asking. Revoke them one by one under "Sites that no longer ask".

settingsModeAlwaysHint.message: Every risky action opens a window. Not clicking within 60s counts as a refusal.

settingsDenyHint.message: One domain per line. These are refused outright, with no window at all. Writing example.com also refuses subdomains such as a.example.com.

settingsApprovedHint.message: Only per_domain uses this list. The toolbar panel can revoke them too.

settingsApprovedEmpty.message: None yet — every site still asks.

settingsAuditHint.message: Records which site had what done to it, whether it worked and how long it took. Never the page text, never cookie values, never what you typed.

settingsRetentionHint.message: Log files older than this are deleted automatically. 0 or less means never delete.

settingsOffline.message: Cannot reach the local program, so nothing can be changed.

settingsOffline1.message: Run `browse daemon start` in a terminal.

settingsOffline2.message: If that still fails, run `browse install` again — it re-registers the messaging config.

settingsOffline3.message: Then reload this page. What you see below is the last thing read, not lost settings.

settingsBadRetention.message: Keep-for must be a whole number.

settingsFeaturesHint.message: Everything this extension can do — all on by default. Untick a box to turn a feature off everywhere; type domains (space- or comma-separated) in the box to turn it off for those sites only. example.com also covers a.example.com.

settingsFeatDomains.message: Off for these domains only, space-separated
